title: Every SaaS rebuilds the same infrastructure. AI just made it faster — and less consistent.
lede: Before you write your product, you need auth, billing, teams, permissions. In 2026, most SaaS founders use AI assistants to build. Nearly all of them are improvising the same infrastructure, differently every session.
ledeCombined: Before you write your product, you need auth, billing, teams, permissions. AI improvises all of it differently every session. In 2026, most SaaS founders use AI assistants to build. Nearly all of them are improvising the same infrastructure, differently every session. Fonderie is the control layer — one system that directs AI to build correctly, however you ship.

items.title: Login and signup
items.text: AI improvises this every session. Different bugs. Different APIs. Inconsistent security.

items.title: Billing and subscriptions
items.text: AI generates different Stripe wiring every time. Some sessions forget webhooks. Others skip invoice logic.

items.title: Team invites and permissions
items.text: AI builds access control differently each time. One session uses roles. Another uses flags. Neither matches your auth.

items.title: Email notifications
items.text: AI reinvents email logic per session. Templates, queues, retry logic — rebuilt from scratch, differently every time.

items.title: Security and compliance
items.text: AI skips rate limiting in some sessions. Hardcodes secrets in others. No two builds handle auth the same way.

byHandText: 2–3 months and $30,000–$60,000. And you still have to get auth right.
withAiText: Your assistant improvises from scratch every session — different login flows, different billing logic, different bugs. It wastes hours (and your AI budget) debugging the same problems over and over.
withFonderieText: Fonderie's control layer specifies and verifies every build. Same login flow every time. Same billing logic. Same security. You spend your time talking to customers. Without Fonderie, every AI session starts from zero — it doesn't know your auth, your billing, your stack. Fonderie is the standard that remembers, so the AI doesn't have to.
